title: Correct Static Types at Shot Pattern GUI and Physics Boundaries
body:
## Problem

Mypy found optional Qt-header dereferences, an incompatible resize-event override, and untyped expanded physics keyword calls.

## Acceptance Criteria

Guard optional headers, accept the Qt base signature, use explicitly typed physics calls, cast the numeric refinement rows explicitly, and pass package mypy plus existing GUI/core tests. Preserve scientific behavior and frozen provenance.

## Validation

Package mypy with Python 3.12; explicit typed Qt/physics boundaries and numerics.py refinement row casts; existing core/GUI/numerics tests.

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
